Devi Ever FX   Devi Ever : CYMRU   Devi Ever FX Spectacular series 75 products » Devi's workspace Devi Ever Devi Ever About Devi Ever FX Devi Ever FX was started by Devi Ever under the name Effector 13 and is located in Portland, OR - USA. Timeline (by Devi Ever) I founded the business sometime in late 2003. In 2008 I licensed my original company name, Effector 13, and a few of my more popular designs to a company called Ooh La La Manufacturing , but after two years I regained my rights to those names. It was during that period of handing over some of my work to OLL that I continued building pedals under the Devi Ever name.
